app.name: Uplift
app.tagline: Copy that converts, proven by experiments.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Start optimizing your pages in minutes.

errors.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project is a page you want to convert better.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.description: Create your first project from the URL of the page you want to optimize.

projects.createDescription: Tell us which page you want to optimize. You can change this later.

hints.url: The public page whose copy you want to improve.

errors.url: Enter a public URL starting with http:// or https://

projects.deleteDescription: The project and all its data will be deleted. This cannot be undone. To just hide it, archive it instead.

stepDescriptions.elements: Pick the copy on the page you want to optimize: headlines, CTAs, benefits…
stepDescriptions.brief: Describe the brand voice, the business and the legal rules the AI must follow.
stepDescriptions.variants: Generate, review and select copy variants for each element.
stepDescriptions.goals: Define what counts as a conversion: clicks, URL visits or events.
stepDescriptions.preview: Review the page with the variants applied on desktop and mobile.
stepDescriptions.activation: Install the script on your site and launch the experiment.
stepDescriptions.results: Compare variants and find out which one converts best.

overview.detailsDescription: The AI uses the industry, page type and market to tailor the copy.
overview.statusDescription: Where the project is in the process.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

elements.title: Elements to optimize
elements.dialogDescription: An element is one specific piece of copy: a headline, a button, a benefit…

placeholders.name: e.g. Main headline
placeholders.originalText: Paste the copy exactly as it appears on the page
placeholders.notes: e.g. Keep the mention of the 14-day free trial

hints.selector: Identifies the element on the page. e.g. #hero h1, .pricing .cta-primary
hints.originalText: The starting point (the control version) for generating variants.
hints.overLimit: The original copy is over the maximum: variants will be shorter.
hints.length: Optional. Limits variant length so they fit the design.

errors.range: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum

elements.deleteDescription: Its variants will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No elements yet
empty.description: Add the copy on the page you want to improve. Start with what drives conversion most: the headline and the main button.

tips.title: Prefer to type the selector?
tips.step1: Open the page in Chrome, right-click the text and choose “Inspect”.
tips.step2: In the Elements panel, right-click the highlighted node → Copy → Copy selector.
tips.step3: Paste it here and simplify it if it is very long.
tips.stable: Prefer ids or meaningful classes (#hero-title) over long :nth-child paths, which break when the page changes.

picker.title: Pick an element
picker.description: Hover over the page and click the copy you want to optimize. Links are disabled.
picker.capturingHint: We load it in a real browser so it looks just like your site. This can take a few seconds.

errors.blocked_url: The URL points to a private or disallowed address. Use the public page URL.
errors.timeout: The page took too long to load.
errors.unreachable: The page isn't responding or returns an error. Check the project URL.
errors.too_large: The page is too large to capture.
errors.rate_limited: Too many refreshes. Wait a minute.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

tagInput.hint: Type and press Enter to add. Paste several lines to add many at once.

brief.neverSaved: You haven't saved the brief yet.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes to the brief will be lost if you leave now.

sectionDescriptions.business: The context the AI needs to write copy that sells on this page.
sectionDescriptions.voice: How the brand sounds, so variants read like your team wrote them.
sectionDescriptions.truth: What can and cannot be claimed. The AI only uses facts from this list.
sectionDescriptions.guardrails: Rules no variant may break. They are checked on generation.

business.offering: e.g. Home insurance with 24/7 assistance and urgent repairs included
business.audience: e.g. Families renting or buying their first home
business.objections: e.g. “The price will go up later”

voice.notes: e.g. Short sentences. No jargon. We say “your home”, not “the property”.

guardrails.disclaimers: e.g. Price for a 90 m² home in London. Terms apply.

business.valueProps: Why someone would choose your product. One per line.
business.objections: Doubts that hold conversion back; variants will try to address them.

truth.facts: Real data, figures and guarantees the AI may quote as they are.
truth.forbiddenClaims: Claims that must not be made, however tempting.

guardrails.bannedWords: Separate with commas or Enter. No variant may contain them.
guardrails.requiredMentions: Texts that must appear where relevant.
guardrails.disclaimers: Legal texts that go with certain claims (prices, returns…).
guardrails.avoidStyles: Copywriting devices that don't fit your brand.

riskLevelDescriptions.high: Regulated industry: only facts from the source of truth, with their disclaimers.

regulated.title: Regulated industry
regulated.description: Marketing claims in {{industry}} are regulated. We recommend a high risk level.

completeness.title: Brief quality
completeness.description: The more complete it is, the better and safer the variants.

variants.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. shorter and punchier, try a savings angle…
variants.empty: No variants for this element yet.
variants.complianceHint: Automatic check for banned words, forbidden claims and length.
variants.qualityHint: The AI's rating: clarity, relevance and persuasiveness.

errors.alreadyRunning: A generation is already running for this project.
errors.rateLimited: Too many generations in a row. Wait a minute.

failed.description: Try again with “Generate more”. If it keeps failing, review the original copy and the brief.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: No Claude API key is configured, so variants come from sample templates. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to use the real AI.

weakBrief.title: The brief is thin
weakBrief.description: With more context about the business and brand, the variants will be much better.

noElements.title: Add elements first
noElements.description: Variants are generated for the copy you mark as elements on the page.

goals.title: Conversion goals
goals.description: Which visitor action counts as a conversion in the experiment.
goals.dialogDescription: Define how we detect that a visitor converted.

kindHints.click: When a button or link is clicked.
kindHints.pageview: When a page is reached, e.g. the “thank you” page.
kindHints.event: When your site sends a custom event.

hints.eventName: Letters, numbers, dashes, dots or colons.

errors.regex: The regular expression is not valid

test.label: Try a URL
test.match: This URL counts as a conversion
test.noMatch: This URL doesn't count as a conversion

goals.deleteDescription: It will no longer be measured in experiments.
goals.deletePrimaryDescription: It's the primary goal: the next oldest goal will become primary.

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.description: Without a goal there's no way to tell which variant wins. Start with the page's most important action.

primaryHelp.title: Primary goal
primaryHelp.description: The metric that decides the winning variant. Secondary goals are measured too, to catch side effects.

preview.notFoundHint: The selector doesn't match this element in the current snapshot.

noSnapshot.title: No snapshot of the page yet
noSnapshot.description: We load the page in a real browser to show you how the variants look.
